blogs.title: Young Apostles Face Debibi United in First Regional Derby of GPL Season
blogs.author: Young Apostles FC
blogs.excerpt: Young Apostles FC will make the short trip to Derby Presby Park on Sunday for a Matchday 3 encounter against Debibi United FC in the 2026/27 Ghana Premier League. The fixture will mark the first regional derby involving Young Apostles in the Ghana Premier League this season.
blogs.content:
Young Apostles FC will make the short trip to Derby Presby Park on Sunday for a Matchday 3 encounter against Debibi United FC in the 2026/27 Ghana Premier League.

The fixture will mark the first regional derby involving Young Apostles in the Ghana Premier League this season, with both sides set for another chapter in a growing local rivalry.

Young Apostles head into the contest with momentum after securing their first league victory of the campaign, a 1-0 home win over Basake Holy Stars, courtesy of an early Samuel Prempeh strike.

Apostles Hold the Head-to-Head Advantage

The two clubs have met five times in all competitions, with Young Apostles holding the better record. The Apostles have recorded three wins, one draw and one defeat, scoring six goals and conceding four.

A Strong Record at Derby Presby Park

Young Apostles have enjoyed success at Debibi Presby Park in their previous competitive meetings. The Apostles became the first club to defeat Debibi United at their home ground, winning 1-0 in a Division One League encounter.

With both clubs now competing in the Ghana Premier League, Sunday's meeting carries added significance. Young Apostles will be looking to build on their Matchday 2 victory and maintain their positive record against Debibi United, while the hosts will be seeking to claim the points on home soil.

The first regional derby of the season awaits.

Debibi United FC vs Young Apostles FC • GPL MD3 • Derby Presby Park • Sun 20th Sep • 3:00PM

blogs.title: Samuel Prempeh Strike Earns Young Apostles First Win of the Season
blogs.author: Young Apostles FC
blogs.excerpt: Young Apostles FC secured their first victory of the 2026/27 Ghana Premier League season with a narrow 1-0 win over Basake Holy Stars in Wenchi. Samuel Prempeh provided the decisive moment, scoring early to give the Apostles the lead.
blogs.content:
Young Apostles FC secured their first victory of the 2026/27 Ghana Premier League season with a narrow 1-0 win over Basake Holy Stars in Wenchi.

Samuel Prempeh provided the decisive moment, scoring early to give the Apostles the lead and set the tone for a determined home performance.

Having suffered a 3-0 defeat to Vision FC on Matchday 1, Young Apostles responded with a disciplined display to claim all three points in their first home league game of the campaign.

The victory also extends Young Apostles' unbeaten record against Basake Holy Stars in Wenchi. The Apostles had won the previous two meetings at home by identical 2-0 scorelines, and Prempeh's early strike ensured that Holy Stars once again left Wenchi without a victory.

The Apostles managed the game effectively after taking the lead, protecting their advantage until the final whistle to give the home supporters a winning start to the club's home league campaign.

The result moves Young Apostles onto three points after two matches.

FULL TIME: Young Apostles FC 1-0 Basake Holy Stars
Scorer: Samuel Prempeh

blogs.title: Young Apostles Set for Basake Holy Stars Test in Wenchi
blogs.author: Young Apostles FC
blogs.excerpt: Young Apostles FC will return to action on Matchday 2 of the 2026/27 Ghana Premier League season when they host Basake Holy Stars in their first home league fixture of the campaign at Wenchi.
blogs.content:
Young Apostles FC will return to action on Matchday 2 of the 2026/27 Ghana Premier League season when they host Basake Holy Stars in their first home league fixture of the campaign at Wenchi.

The Apostles will be looking to bounce back from their opening-day defeat to Vision FC, where they suffered a 3-0 loss in Tema. With the home support behind them, Young Apostles will be aiming to put their first points of the season on the board.

Holy Stars Yet to Win in Wenchi

Basake Holy Stars arrive in Wenchi looking for a first victory at the venue, but their previous visits have ended in defeats. The two most recent meetings between the sides in Wenchi have both gone the way of Young Apostles, with the Apostles recording 2-0 victories in each encounter.

Apostles Ready to Respond

Assistant Coach Abubakar Fuseini says the team has addressed the mistakes from the opening-day defeat and is ready for the challenge ahead.

"The players lost concentration at certain moments against Vision, but we've worked on those mistakes and we are fully prepared for Holy Stars."

Young Apostles FC vs Basake Holy Stars • Sun 12th Sep • 3:00PM • Wenchi Sports Stadium

blogs.title: Young Apostles Fall to 3-0 Defeat Against Vision FC in GPL Opener
blogs.author: Young Apostles FC
blogs.excerpt: Young Apostles FC began their 2026/27 Ghana Premier League campaign with a 3-0 defeat to Vision FC on Saturday, September 5, 2026, at the Nii Adjei Kraku II Sports Complex.
blogs.content:
Young Apostles FC began their 2026/27 Ghana Premier League campaign with a 3-0 defeat to Vision FC on Saturday, September 5, 2026, at the Nii Adjei Kraku II Sports Complex.

The Apostles entered the opening fixture looking to start the new campaign on a positive note, but Vision FC took control early and opened the scoring in the fifth minute through Nyenye Naziru.

Young Apostles were unable to find an equaliser before the break, and Vision doubled their advantage in the 40th minute when Setsofia Aqetey found the back of the net to send the hosts into halftime with a 2-0 lead.

The second half saw Young Apostles push for a response, but Vision remained in control. Aqetey completed his brace in the 68th minute to make it 3-0.

Despite efforts from the Apostles to get back into the contest, Vision held on to secure all three points in the opening game of the 2026/27 league season.

Young Apostles will now turn their attention to their next fixture, against Basake Holy Stars, as they look to respond and put their first points of the campaign on the board.

FULL TIME: Vision FC 3-0 Young Apostles FC
Scorers: Naziru (5') • Aqetey (40', 68')
